item.title: CVE-2026-122318 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.2
item.description: Thursday 5 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.2 | Kyverno before 1.19.2 contains an authentication bypass in matchCertificateData that skips verifyImages subject and subjectRegExp checks when the signing certificate has no Subject Alternative Name. Attackers holding a leaf certificate from a configured private trust root can omit the SAN, set the expected Fulcio issuer OID, and sign malicious images that are admitted despite signer pinning.

item.title: CVE-2026-122319 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Thursday 5 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Kyverno before 1.19.2 contains a denial-of-service vulnerability in the In and NotIn operators that allows attackers to crash the policy engine via an unchecked type assertion. Attackers can submit resources whose JMESPath-evaluated values yield arrays of integers, booleans, or mixed types, triggering a panic that disrupts admission control and policy enforcement.

item.title: CVE-2026-122320 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Thursday 5 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | Kyverno before 1.19.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows namespaced Policy authors to read resources in other namespaces by templating generate.clone or cloneList namespace values. Attackers can annotate a triggering ConfigMap so the background-controller copies a victim namespace's sensitive ConfigMap into the attacker's namespace, enabling cross-tenant data disclosure.

item.title: CVE-2026-122321 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Thursday 5 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | Kyverno 1.18.0 before 1.19.2 contains a signature verification bypass in verifyImages because cached verification results are keyed by the image reference string (such as a tag) rather than bound to the verified digest, so cache hits skip signature and attestation checks. An attacker who can submit workloads and move a registry tag can warm the cache with a signed image, repoint the tag, and have Kyverno admit the workload and use mutateDigest to pin the unverified digest.

item.title: CVE-2026-122322 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Thursday 5 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Kyverno from 1.11.0 before 1.19.2 contains an unbounded decompression vulnerability in extractStatement that allows remote attackers to exhaust memory by supplying highly compressed attestation layers. Attackers controlling registry referrer artifacts can push gzip predicate layers exceeding maxPayloadSize when decompressed, causing admission controller OOM kills and denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-122323 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Thursday 5 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Kyverno from 1.11.0 before 1.19.2 contains an unbounded decompression vulnerability in FetchSignatureBlob that allows attackers to exhaust memory by supplying highly compressed notary signature layers. Attackers who control registry referrers or signatures can publish small gzip layers that decompress beyond maxPayloadSize, causing admission controller OOM kills and denial of service.

item.description: Thursday 5 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1 | A vulnerability has been found in OpenHands up to 1.24.0. This impacts an unknown function of the component Landing Page.
